mainText: Hello, Verona! At 9 AM, we are looking at clear skies and 55 degrees at the Verona Area High School, with a waning crescent moon phase in effect.
The City of Verona Plan Commission meets this Wednesday to review multiple projects, including a final plat for Ardent Glen and pending site plans for Sub-Zero at Liberty Business Park.
There is plenty to do with Hop Haus Trivia today, Quizmasters Trivia at Lake Lou-ee tonight, and the Verona Downtown Farmer's Market coming up tomorrow.
In a noteworthy call from September 28, a 71-year-old Madison man was cited for failing to keep his vehicle under control after a crash at the intersection of CTH-PB and CTH-M.
Stop by to enjoy today's delicious Peanut Butter Fudge Brownie flavor when the store opens today at 10:00 AM.
